novelty_flags.label: Proposition 3 (prop:uncoupled-reduction)
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposition is explicitly an already-known ignorability reduction covered by Cattaneo (2010), so it must be removed from the proposal's novel solve-target set or retained only as an unnumbered validation benchmark.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For continuous Z the paper states that exact efficiency requires an infinite-dimensional variance minimization, then deliberately restricts estimation to a finite-dimensional class generated by prespecified weighting functions and calls the resulting estimator locally optimal.

The paper gives finite-dimensional basis approximations to the efficient IF and characterizes the minimum-variance member of the indexed-invariance IF class; it distinguishes this from attainment under a fuller mean-scale model unless first-order restrictions are exhausted.
The paper develops cross-fit doubly robust spline estimators and fast remainder rates for average linear functionals of conditional expectations.

The paper studies multivalued treatment effects under ignorability and supplies an EIF and semiparametric efficiency bound for regular estimators; the proposal's b=0 armwise benchmark is within this established uncoupled setting.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Move the b=0 uncoupled reduction out of the numbered to-prove core into an explicit software-validation or appendix benchmark, while retaining its exact expected solver output.

Add a direct comparison theorem that maps Guo et al.'s prescribed density family into the proposal's feasible subspace and states the strict-inclusion condition under which global attainment improves their continuous-Z estimator.

Make the primitive concentration OEQ the first Stage-0 target and prove its total learner event with explicit constants for clipping, denominators, and operator perturbation before developing the global CLT.

recommended_next_step: Revise by demoting the published uncoupled sanity corollary from the novelty-bearing core; the remaining primitive global-attainment kernel is field-tier and can then advance to Stage 0.
